items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And Lee says, you direct and she will play the piano.

ctx.x: I used to conduct the show. That's -- I started when the Nicholas -- Mrs. Nicholas, she -- I was supposed to play the piano, see. I wasn't supposed to direct it. And I told the man -- he said, you go on and direct the show.
Lee Whippet was this great movie star, one of our first great-name movie stars.
Yeah. And Lee says, you direct and she will play the piano. Okay, I said.
